provenance.source: Ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osob fizycznych (PIT Act); Social Insurance System Act; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Poland (reviewed 11 August 2026)
provenance.notes: The tax scale, the PLN 3,600 tax-reducing amount, the 2026 social security cap of PLN 282,600 and the non-deductibility of the health contribution were read from PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries on 31 August 2026.

verificationTodo: Confirm the standard employee deductible costs of PLN 250 a month (PLN 300 for a commuter from another town), which were not re-checked in this pass.
Confirm the PLN 85,528 exemption limit for the under-26 relief for 2026.
Confirm the minimum health insurance contribution rules, which this app does not apply.
omissions: Joint filing with a spouse and the single-parent calculation are out of scope.
The child relief (ulga na dzieci), the 4+ children relief, the return relief and the working-pensioner relief are not modelled.
The solidarity levy of 4% above PLN 1,000,000 of income is modelled, but only against employment income.
The minimum monthly health contribution for low earners is not applied.

Where the under-26 exemption applies, contributions and deductible costs are apportioned to the taxable share of pay. That reflects the rule that costs relating to exempt income are not deductible, but it is a simplification of the month-by-month way payroll actually applies it.

scale.note: Two rates only. The PLN 30,000 tax-free amount is delivered as a PLN 3,600 reduction of the tax itself, not as an allowance against income - 12% of 30,000 is exactly 3,600.

socialInsurance.note: Pension and disability contributions of 11.26% stop at an ANNUAL cap of PLN 282,600 of base. Sickness insurance of 2.45% has no cap. Both are deducted from income before tax.

healthInsurance.legalRef: Act on health care services financed from public funds
healthInsurance.note: 9% of gross pay less the social contributions. Since 2022 it is NOT deductible from tax or from income, so it behaves like a second flat tax rather than a contribution.

deductibleCosts.note: A fixed monthly amount, not a percentage and not actual expenses.

youthRelief.note: Employment income of taxpayers under 26 is exempt up to PLN 85,528 a year. Social and health contributions are still due on it.

solidarityLevy.note: A separate 4% levy on income above PLN 1,000,000, declared separately from the annual return.

regions.name: Poland
regions.note: Polish personal income tax has no regional component.

inputSchema.label: Wynagrodzenie brutto (gross pay, per month)
inputSchema.help: Gross monthly pay in zloty. Month-by-month entry lets the app apply the annual social security cap at the point in the year where you actually reach it.

inputSchema.label: Advance tax withheld (per month)
inputSchema.help: The PIT advance your employer withheld each month, for the annual comparison.

inputSchema.label: I commute from a different town
inputSchema.help: Raises the standard deductible cost from PLN 250 to PLN 300 a month. It is a fixed amount; actual travel costs are not deductible.

inputSchema.label: I am under 26 (ulga dla mlodych)
inputSchema.help: Employment income is exempt from tax up to PLN 85,528 a year. Social security and the 9% health contribution are still payable on the exempt income.
